V1_eta_shift.fails_if: a residual above 1e-12, or a null space of dimension other than 1, or a null direction other than eta

V2_homogeneous_and_vacuum.reading: a uniform M(t) has L = -V4, so the certified action carries no cosmological constant of its own (Lambda_own = 0) and no homogeneous negative energy density; the orbit check shows the vacuum manifold is the full O(1,3) orbit
V2_homogeneous_and_vacuum.fails_if: any F entry above 1e-14 on a time-only jet, or V4(M_vac) above 1e-20, or a negative V4 sample, or V4 above 1e-12 on the orbit

V3_V10_kinetic_norms_about_M_vac.reading: the curvature term gives no quadratic kinetic norm to any direction about the uniform vacuum (F is bilinear in two different derivative directions); K_T is nonzero on the boosts only; K_cov is sign-indefinite across the ten; K_h = K_cov + 2K_T signs listed per direction
V3_V10_kinetic_norms_about_M_vac.fails_if: -4I1 nonzero on a single-derivative jet, or K_T nonzero on a non-boost direction, or any K_h sign differing from the package's census when compared at R2

V10_director_term_on_a_hedgehog.exterior_energy_of_kappa*sum||dS||^2_fro: 16 pi kappa D^2 (R - r0): linear in R
V10_director_term_on_a_hedgehog.fails_if: the sampled coefficient differs from 4 beyond 1e-6

V6_stress_trace.reading: T^mu_mu = sum_mu <dL/dA_mu, A_mu> - 4 L = 4 L_kin - 4 (L_kin + L_pot) = -4 L_pot = 4 V4 in this sign convention (the author writes -4V with the opposite overall sign); the curvature term drops out of the trace in four dimensions. Static consequence (Derrick): E_F = 3 E_V, E_V / E = 1/4 for any stationary finite-energy state; checked on a stored relaxed hedgehog in part 2

V14_E_dot_B.reading: exact for the director's area-form reading of the field, by the dimension of S^2; the magnetic moment then has no E.B route and is the circulation of the charge, as the package states
V14_E_dot_B.fails_if: a nonzero value above 1e-12 for a pullback f, or a zero for the generic contrast

V49_separate_invariances.reading: the certified action is invariant under the two groups separately (residuals at round-off); a term that contracts the record's u with d_mu is invariant only under the diagonal, which is where a fixed clock enters. This is a symmetry statement about the ACTION; the row's open item (a boosted defect measured in-sim) is a dynamics measurement and is not closed by it
V49_separate_invariances.fails_if: either L_cert residual above 1e-10, or the rule-R-like term NOT breaking one of the two factors (both its single-factor residuals below 1e-10)
